context_for_next_testing_agent: Payment security and billing alerts (Le Garagiste) features verified: 1) POST /api/payments/checkout/session accepts price_id (new) and package_id (legacy), does NOT accept amount from client, supports optional promo_code. 2) Server calculates final_amount from SUBSCRIPTION_PACKAGES (annual=30€, postpartum=10€). 3) Webhook compares received amount with server_expected_amount metadata and records billing alert on mismatch. 4) GET /api/payments/billing-alerts returns alerts list with has_critical status. 5) POST /api/payments/billing-alerts/{index}/resolve marks alert as resolved. 6) Admin dashboard shows green indicator when no alerts, red pulsing card when alerts exist. 7) PremiumSunAvatar has 30 sparkles dispersed across halo and floating-avatar animation (5px vertical, 10s).
